lead.headline: Cherry Blossom flipped first place before breakfast
lead.dek: AB81 woke up ahead. Then Cherry Blossom’s Tee Higgins put up 20.2 in the early game, and the lead was gone: 35.78 to 22.58. The leader is down to 21.9% and its one fix locks at Sun 10:00 AM.
lead.pull: Cherry Blossom 35.78, AB81 22.58. Eight starters left against nine.
body: I’ve covered Cherry Blossom all season, and this franchise doesn’t usually do mornings. Today it did. It started Sunday trailing the 7-1 team on a Thursday kicker, and by the time anyone in Pacific time had found the coffee, it was ahead 35.78 to 22.58. The win odds now read 78.1% Cherry Blossom, 21.9% AB81.

The whole swing is one receiver. Tee Higgins was projected for 16.36 and already has 20.2, with his game still going. Add Trevor Lawrence’s 13.58 and 2.0 from the Baltimore defense and that’s the number. AB81 is frozen at 22.58: Cam Little’s 17.0 and Derrick Henry’s 5.58, nothing playing, nothing new since Thursday.

Here’s why the lead looks sturdy. Cherry Blossom still has eight starters to play, and the top of that list is mean: Puka Nacua at 23.45, Christian McCaffrey at 22.61, Brock Bowers at 18.55, Jared Goff at 19.78. The live projection is 173.0 to 143.62. And the lineup is basically clean, 173.46 as set, 174.33 at its best.

AB81 has nine starters left and one real lever. George Kittle is on the bench at 15.68 while Makai Lemon starts at receiver for 7.91. The shuffle still works: Kittle in at tight end, Dallas Goedert to flex, Darius Cooper to receiver, Lemon out. It moves the AB81 lineup from 139.5 to 147.27. Sleeper says the deadline is Sun 1:05 PM. The real clock is Sun 10:00 AM, when Lemon, Goedert and Cooper kick off. As of 8:48 AM, it’s still on the board.

My call hasn’t changed, it just got easier to make: Cherry Blossom. AB81 needs the shuffle, a monster Jaxon Smith-Njigba day at 24.1, and Joe Milton, at 12.26, to play like somebody who isn’t the backup plan. This team is 7-1 with an all-play of 28-28. It lives on long odds. This morning it got longer ones.
